steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience necessary. This makes CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-career professionals across Virginia Beach's Military & Defense, Healthcare, IT, and Construction sectors who want to formalize their credentials quickly.

steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format fits working schedules, allowing you to earn your required education without travel or inflexible classroom hours—perfect for balancing current employment or other commitments in the Virginia Beach area.

steps_items.heading: Apply to PMI and Pay Exam Fee
steps_items.text: Submit your PMI application with proof of your completed education. PMI will validate your eligibility and collect the exam fee. This step typically takes one to two weeks; our team guides you through every form and requirement to ensure a smooth submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. You'll sit for the proctored CAPM exam online, on your schedule. Our active certified practitioners provide targeted feedback to address knowledge gaps before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After earning CAPM, commit to a three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or other PMI-approved activities. We offer ongoing PDU courses to keep your credential active and your skills current in your career.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
